test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 3 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Six years hence Sunil will be twice as old as Kamal. Two years ago he was four times as old as Kamal. Find the present age of Kamal.
solution:
**Given:**

Six years hence Sunil will be twice as old as Kamal.

Two years ago Sunil was four times as old as Kamal.

**Formula Used:**

Let the present age of Sunil be S years and the present age of Kamal be K years.

1. S + 6 = 2(K + 6)

2. S - 2 = 4(K - 2)
